  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: submit_metrics, query_timeseries_points

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3

def compare_metric_values(resource1, resource2, metric_type, start_time, end_time):
    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
    project_name = f"projects/{os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')}"
    
    interval = monitoring_v3.types.TimeInterval(
        start_time=monitoring_v3.types.Timestamp(seconds=start_time),
        end_time=monitoring_v3.types.Timestamp(seconds=end_time)
    )
    
    query = f"metric.type=\"{metric_type}\" AND resource.label.\"resource_id\"=\"{resource1}\""
    request = monitoring_v3.types.ListTimeSeriesRequest(
        name=project_name,
        interval=interval,
        filter=query,
        aggregate_settings=monitoring_v3.types.AggregationSettings(
            group_by_fields=["resource.type", "metric.type"]
        )
    )
    responses1 = client.list_time_series(request=query)

    query = f"metric.type=\"{metric_type}\" AND resource.label.\"resource_id\"=\"{resource2}\""
    request = monitoring_v3.types.ListTimeSeriesRequest(
        name=project_name,
        interval=interval,
        filter=query,
        aggregate_settings=monitoring_v3.types.AggregationSettings(
            group_by_fields=["resource.type", "metric.type"]
        )
    )
    responses2 = client.list_time_series(request=query)

    data1 = [point.value for series in responses1 for point in series.points]
    data2 = [point.value for series in responses2 for point in series.points]
    
    if len(data1) != len(data2):
        raise ValueError("Metric data points do not match in length")
    
    result = [(d1, d2) for d1, d2 in zip(data1, data2)]
    return result
```
